parent_v2_4.rule: v2.4 result is immutable; v2.5 generalizes the planner API without altering the frozen BAM result.

goal: Generalize falsification-driven evidence design from the fixed BAM intervention library to any finite world set and any predeclared observation/intervention library.

generic_inputs.current_signature_by_world: the evidence-equivalence signature already known for each world
generic_inputs.candidate_evidence_library: finite mapping evidence_id -> predicted outcome by world
generic_inputs.optional_active_world_ids: subset of currently surviving worlds; default is the full finite universe

generic_outputs: exact minimum separating evidence set or null

hypotheses.claim: The generic API reproduces every frozen v2.4 planner output on the BAM intervention library.
hypotheses.rule: Any mismatch in unresolved pairs, intervention split counts, minimum set, or final classes refutes G1.

hypotheses.claim: If the evidence library cannot split every unresolved world pair, the generic API returns no minimum separating set and retains explicit unresolved classes.
hypotheses.rule: Returning a separating set when uncovered pairs remain refutes G2.

hypotheses.claim: After a finite compatible-world set contracts, planning on the surviving subset yields the exact minimum design for that subset without using eliminated worlds.
hypotheses.rule: Any dependence on eliminated worlds or mismatch with exhaustive subset search refutes G3.

hypotheses.claim: Adding a new declared evidence channel cannot merge two worlds that were already separated by the previous evidence signature.
hypotheses.rule: Any increase in equivalence-class size after appending evidence refutes G4.

insufficiency_fixture.expected: H-only passive alias pairs remain uncovered; minimum separating set is null.

contracted_fixture.active_world_policy: Select the first lexicographically ordered world from each P-only passive alias pair plus all passive singletons; exclude the paired P-alias mate.
contracted_fixture.expected: The remaining unresolved aliases are H-only; exact minimum separating set is {H_long_corridor_challenge}.

implementation_boundary: No BAM-specific logic in the generic planner module.
No evidence channel may be invented after outcomes.
If the supplied library is insufficient, return unresolved rather than weakening the target.
The planner certifies separation only inside the supplied finite world universe.
